American Battery Technology Company gets BIS export license for up to $100M of recycled black mass — TradingView News Search Products Community Markets Brokers More EN Get started News / TradingView / American Battery Technology Company gets BIS export license for up to $100M of recycled black mass American Battery Technology Company gets BIS export license for up to $100M of recycled black mass Less than 1 min read ABAT American Battery Technology Company received a U.S. Department of Commerce license to export up to $100 million of recycled black mass, supporting its commercial scale-up. Key Highlights: BIS granted a license to export up to $100 million of recycled black mass under new federal export controls, enabling international sales. License supports the company’s commercial recycling operations and strengthens its position in critical mineral supply chains. Company reported over 400% year-over-year revenue growth and is scaling a second recycling facility backed by $150M in DOE grants. First commercial-scale recycling facility near Reno began operations in 2023 and produces lithium-rich intermediates and other recovered materials. Original SEC Filing: AMERICAN BATTERY TECHNOLOGY Co [ ABAT ] - 8-K - Oct. 01, 2026 Disclaimer This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
